blueprints.title: Symbolic Failure Gradients and Meta-Prompt Optimization for Complex Multi-Step Tasks

blueprints.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces and AST Lint Sandboxing for Software Engineering
blueprints.abstract: Demonstrates that structured Agent-Computer Interfaces (ACI), AST pre-write lint checks, and 250-line file view limits achieve 12.5% pass@1 on SWE-bench by blocking syntax corruptions.

blueprints.title: Two-Level Recursive Agent Harness for Autonomous Software Engineering
blueprints.abstract: Presents Harness², a two-level recursive architecture separating intra-task behavioral contrast loops from inter-task meta-reflection with strict KEEP_BASE default gates and 28-skill cue-matched retrieval.
